E-Smart Corp. (“the Company”, “we”,
“us” or “our”) was incorporated on June 6, 2023 under the laws of the State of Nevada United States of America.
E-Smart Corp. operates a digital platform for tattoo artist discovery and design. Our platform provides a catalog of tattoo artists, with
profiles that allow prospective clients to review artists’ work. We also publish monthly tattoo related news and information to
keep users informed about industry developments, tattoo styles, new materials, and innovations.
AI Tattoo Generator
AI Tattoo Generator (the “AI Tattoo Idea
Generator API”) is a digital tool for developing tattoo design ideas. It allows users submit an idea at https://e-smart.io/idea-generator/,
and produce tattoo sketches to explore. As a product, it serves the idea development stage of the tattoo journey, helping users give shape
to a concept before deciding how to pursue it with an artist. The free option gives users access to the generator.
Our primary executive office is located at Pau Claris
79, Barcelona 8010, Spain, and we can be reached via phone at +16203079197.
Our Web Site
Our website is located at https://e-smart.io.
Monetization Strategy
Our monetization strategy includes offering
access to the AI Tattoo Idea Generator API through an application programming interface, enabling businesses and developers to leverage
our technology to enhance their own products and services.
The service is offered based on plans. Businesses
and developers can integrate this technology into their products and services by subscribing to the API. The Starter and Power Pack provide
access for one month with different allowances: 1,000 and 2,500 API requests, respectively. Businesses and developers can submit a request
through the website to access a paid plan. Paid plans are payable in advance, and revenue from each plan is recognized ratably over its
one-month term.
We continue to explore other revenue avenues,
including premium features, and strategic partnerships with tattoo-related businesses.
E-Smart Corp. offers a free online Tattoo Cost Calculator that estimates
the price of a tattoo from three inputs: size, color option, and artist experience level. The tool is intended for budgeting and planning
purposes. Estimates are not final quotes; actual pricing is determined by the artist and depends on the design, placement, and studio
rates.
Competition
E-Smart Corp. operates in a highly competitive landscape
within the tattoo industry, where innovation and efficient customer engagement are critical for success. The Company's digital platform
aims to improve how tattoo artists and clients find and engage with one another, with a focus on time saving tools and services. We compete
with online platforms and mobile applications that connect consumers with tattoo artists, as well as with social media platforms such
as Instagram and word of mouth referrals that artists and clients have traditionally used to find one another. We also compete with tattoo
focused AI design generators and visualization apps, and with general purpose AI image generation tools that can be used to create tattoo
concepts. These products may offer features such as prompt based design generation, editing, previews, or stencil creation, and may compete
with our AI powered design tools for users and spending.
Many existing and potential competitors have greater
financial, technical, marketing, and personnel resources than we do, longer operating histories, greater brand recognition, and larger
or more established client and artist bases. These factors may give them a competitive advantage. Competition in AI based design may also
intensify as existing products add features, new products enter the market, or general-purpose tools become more capable of producing
tattoo concepts. We believe our primary competitive factors include the quality and usability of our platform, the functionality of our
AI powered design tools, the size and quality of our artist database, and our pricing. There can be no assurance that we will compete
successfully against current or future competitors.
Promotion and Marketing
We engage third-party providers to support our marketing
activities and plan to expand our marketing efforts as our business develops to promote our platform through social media marketing and
strategic partnerships.
Employees
Ms. Vasylenko, the Company’s President, Chief
Executive Officer, Treasurer, Secretary and Director, continues to devote approximately 40 hours per week to Company matters. Ms. Vasylenko
does not receive any compensation for her services. Other than Ms. Vasylenko, the Company has no employees, full-time or part-time. On
January 30, 2026, the Board of Directors appointed Lukas Diaz and Manuel Martinez Garcia as independent, non-employee directors. The Company’s
Board of Directors currently consists of three directors.
Government Regulation
We are required to comply with all regulations, rules
and directives of governmental authorities and agencies applicable to our operations in any jurisdiction in which we conduct business.
We do not believe that existing or probable government regulation, including applicable export or import controls, will have a material
impact on the way we conduct our business.
Patents, Trademarks and Copyrights
We do not own, either legally or beneficially, any
patents or trademarks. We intend to protect our website (https://e-smart.io/) under copyright law. Other than our trade name, we do not
hold any other intellectual property.
